Example dataset for XWAS summary statistics

Source: R/datasets.R
XWAS_Summary_Example.Rd

Example dataset for XWAS summary statistics

Format

A data frame with 80 rows and 8 variables:

CHROM

Chromosome number (23 for X chromosome); integer

POS

Genomic position (base-pair); integer

ID

SNP identifier (rsID); character string

P

P-value for association; numeric

BETA

Effect size estimate (beta coefficient); numeric

A1

Effect allele; character string

A2

Other allele; character string

EAF

Effect allele frequency; numeric
